title: GLACE Alps – Sentinel-1 Glacier Coherence and Backscatter
description:
Annual summer composites of Sentinel-1 12-day repeat-pass interferometric coherence (COH12) and radiometrically terrain-corrected backscatter (RTC). The data covers the Alpine Convention perimeter, 2015–2026. The analysis-ready composites are locally resolution weighted (LRW) after [Small et al. (2022)](https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2021.3055562), so each output pixel is dominated by acquisitions with high spatial resolution. Each year's 90-day averaging period was chosen by minimizing the MODIS NDSI over the target area.

The composites are available in two separate collections: tiles (10 km × 10 km MGRS grid squares, UTM, 10 m grid spacing) and mosaics on one fixed equal-area grid (ETRS89-LAEA, 40 m grid spacing). Every cloud-optimized GeoTIFF is LERC-compressed and carries its processing record in its own tags. For web maps, such as the [GLACE Viewer](https://lqgentner.github.io/glace-viewer), raster PMTiles in Web Mercator hold 8-bit value-encoded WebP tiles.

providers.name: European Space Agency / Copernicus
providers.description: Operates the Sentinel-1 mission and distributes the SLC data these composites are derived from, through the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem.

providers.name: University of Zurich, Department of Geography
providers.description: Produced the composites from Copernicus Sentinel-1 SLC data: burst extraction, coherence estimation, radiometric terrain correction and local resolution weighted compositing. Derived the annual mosaics and maintains this catalog.
